performance.verdict: Paid ads fully dark; organic GBP declining while GA4 holds — 5 SOW milestones overdue.

findings.text: Live-Cooking Event (Shoot 1) was due 2026-08-14 with no completed event recorded — 20 days overdue.
4 milestones due 2026-08-31 unresolved: Pre-Launch Gate, Platform Ownership, Funnel Test+UTM, SEO Phase 1 — all 3 days overdue.
Meta and Google spend is $0 across all 28 days and every series day — no paid media is running at all.
GBP actions fell 29.29% 7d vs prior 7d; last 3 days (Aug 29–31) show 0 actions vs prior 3-day avg of 34.3 — likely a reporting lag, not a true zero.
GA4 sessions up 5.47% 7d; last 3 days avg 377 vs prior 3-day avg of 265 — organic site interest is growing with zero paid support.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer immediately; block paid relaunch until Funnel Test + UTM live.
suggestions.monday_update: Five SOW milestones are overdue: Live-Cooking Shoot (20 days past Aug 14) and four Aug 31 items (Pre-Launch Gate, Platform Ownership, Funnel Test+UTM, SEO Phase 1). Nacer (Ops) must triage all five and assign hard re-due dates this week. Success is confirmed when each milestone has a new owner-committed date logged in Monday by 2026-09-07. Funnel Test + UTM must close before any paid spend is switched back on.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions: confirm whether Aug 29–31 zeroes are a data lag or real drop before acting.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions show 0 for Aug 29–31, driving the reported -29.29% 7d delta, but the prior 3-day average was 34.3 actions/day. This is most likely a reporting lag in the data pipeline rather than a true collapse in local visibility. Re-check on 2026-09-06 once the lag window closes; if actions remain at 0 for 6+ consecutive days with data confirmed complete, escalate as a GBP visibility issue. No action until data is confirmed.

suggestions.text: Watch GA4 session growth (last 3-day avg 377 vs prior 265) — confirms organic demand exists when paid relaunches.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 sessions are averaging 377/day over the last 3 days versus 265/day in the prior 3, a 42% lift with zero paid spend — organic demand is present. This strengthens the case for restarting Meta spend (SOW budget: $1,000–1,500/mo) once Funnel Test + UTM milestone (F2) is cleared. Re-check paid relaunch readiness on 2026-09-07. Success signal: Meta campaigns live with UTM tracking confirmed firing within 48 hours of relaunch.
